author: JKawesome
body:
Hey guys! So me and an IRL friend of mine were bored today, so we decided to make another map. This map is entirely based off gameplay. I wanted to give it sort of a McZone feeling, so it's made from stone bricks, solid stone, wool, and glowstone.

Oh, and Trans helped me make the monument.

I reshaped the map completely, and added more islands.

replies.author: SpicyTunaRoll9
replies.body:
Also I'm going to give this a -1.
Ok first off, It's extremely easy to spawnblock or spawncamp when one team gains dominance over the other.
Secondly, the monuments are too close to spawn, and would make the enemy team difficult to bridge without constantly getting bowspammed/suicide rushed. Many players could just die, respawn and keep doing the same thing over and over.
Finally, the amount of pvp space is too damn small, and it doesn't offer opportunities like sky-bridging, under-bridging, etc. 
P.S. Many players could abuse the spawn protection by using hit an run tactics. Iron guys could just run back into their spawn when they are low.

replies.author: JKawesome
replies.body:
You can't really spawnblock, other than blocking the entrance to the middle from the bridge. And that wouldn't really work well, since there's no roof on the middle. If the enemy team is spawncamping, you still have opportunities. It's not like your team loses automatically. Just use tactics that work with every other map. Tunnel, skybridge, etc.

I'm pretty sure I just saw a post saying that the monuments are too far away in Luar. In Luar, it used to be 30 blocks away, not sure about now. This monument is 12 blocks away from spawn, compared to Ternio, 17 blocks, or Quintus, 15 blocks. If you want, I can move them farther away.

Don't worry, I'm adding more space on the sides for PvP. Also, there are plenty of tactics you can use. Underbridging works well, even without water. If you look closely, the bedrock under the spawn is 3 blocks higher than under the middle, making it perfect to underbridge. Bridging really far out is another tactic. I'm sure there are more.

 If iron guys run back into the spawn on low health, then isn't that what most diamond guys do on Quintus and Luar?
